message.content: {"caption":"A four-stage diagram of an agent memory system, showing how conversations become notes, notes are linked and evolved, and relevant memories are retrieved for LLM agents.","description":"The diagram is divided into four headed areas: Note Construction, Link Generation, Memory Evolution, and Memory Retrieval. In Note Construction, a globe labeled “Environment” and a bot labeled “LLM Agents” are connected by a bidirectional interaction marked “Interaction.” A downward arrow marked “Write” leads toward two conversation boxes. Conversation 1 asks for help implementing a custom web-application cache that handles both memory and disk storage. Conversation 2 says the cache works but memory use in production is high, and asks about adding an LRU eviction policy. Each conversation points downward to an LLM symbol and then to a blue document-shaped “Note.” Between the two note paths, “Note Attributes” lists Timestamp, Content, Context, Keywords, Tags, and Embedding, with small icons; the embedding is shown as a pink segmented bar. From the right-hand note, a line runs left and upward, then right into the memory collection, with the vertical part labeled “Retrieve.” In Link Generation, a collection labeled “Memory,” with a database-cylinder symbol, contains four outlined boxes labeled Box 1, Box i, Box j, and Box n; each box contains three note icons. A blue downward arrow labeled “Top-k” leads from this collection to a selected note labeled m_i and a small branching network connecting note/link symbols. A right-pointing arrow from this network leads to an LLM symbol. A blue downward arrow labeled “Store” leads to two outlined boxes, Box n+1 and Box n+2, each containing three notes. In Memory Evolution, a dashed outline encloses two boxes labeled Box n+1 and Box n+2, each holding three notes. A downward arrow from this memory area points toward the LLM/action area. Beneath it, “Action” labels a blue downward arrow leading to three note icons; small evolution symbols below them are labeled “Evolve.” In Memory Retrieval, a query symbol labeled “Query” is shown beside “Text Model”; the query is represented as a pink segmented “Query Embedding,” and a left-pointing arrow labeled “Retrieve” leads from this area toward the memory. A rightward path labeled “Top-k” descends into a “Relative Memory” box containing three notes. The first note is circled and marked “1st.” A downward arrow from this box leads to an LLM Agents bot.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
